block.title: In-game enemy sprite sheet: dune worm, dust devil, husk crawler
block.positive: Pixel art sprite sheet, SNES 16-bit arcade style, flat solid deep warm-navy sheet, one enemy family per horizontal band, thick even margins, no text, no frame lines, no labels. Band one — DUNE WORM: an armored drill-worm of segmented brass rings with a conical spiral-tooth maw, shown as head frames rising at increasing angles, plus stackable plain ring segments and a two-frame sand splash puff. Band two — DUST DEVIL: a hollow twisted funnel of rust-colored spinning vapor with orbiting dark pebbles, four rotational frames where the spiral bands climb one quarter-turn each, silhouette wobbling slightly wider between frames. Band three — HUSK CRAWLER: an armored walker drone shaped like a broad beetle, overlapping slate shell plates, six stubby pixel legs in a clean four-step walk cycle, a dim red eye-bar glowing under the shell rim, and one flipped frame with the belly hatch open around a small bright violet core. Bold dark outlines around every sprite, saturated desert palette of brass, rust, sand-gold and slate, chunky cartridge-era readability, dithered highlights on metal only.

block.notes: Landscape three-band layout; easiest to eyeball cycle continuity across the wide strip. flux.1-dev for crisp leg separation. Color reference: eye-bar #ff3a3a, belly core #8a48e8, brass rings warm #e8a030 family.
